title: Hard Water Skin Care: How to Stop Your Face Feeling Tight After Washing
ex: Hard water can leave a soap film that makes skin feel tight and dry. How to check your water at home and a simple, low-cost washing and moisturising routine.
rt: Hard Water Skin Care: Routine for Indian Homes | Mirc Glow
rd: Hard water skin care for Indian homes: why borewell water leaves your face tight, how to check your water, and a simple routine with a filtered-water rinse.
quick: Hard water leaves a mineral and soap film that can make your face feel tight and dry. Wash with lukewarm water and a mild non-soap face wash, finish with a splash of filtered or boiled-and-cooled water, and moisturise within a minute of patting dry.
